{'text': 'The wait between the first two seasons of "Severance" has already been long, and the third season is testing viewers\' patience in a similar way. However, Apple TV has just released a noteworthy update on the show\'s progress.'}

{'text': '"Severance" Season 3 officially begins filming, with a premiere expected at the end of 2027'}

{'text': 'It\'s been roughly 18 months since "Severance" Season 2 premiered. Although progress on Season 3 has not been as fast as expected, it has just reached an important milestone.'}

{'text': 'According to a post by Ben Stiller on X, reshared by the Apple TV account, filming on "Severance" Season 3 has officially begun.'}

{'text': 'The low-resolution production photos Stiller shared appear to show Mark Scout and Helly R. running through a Lumon corridor — bringing to mind the final moments of Season 2.'}

{'text': 'Season 2 ended with a shocking decision from Mark: he chose to stay with Helly, defying his "outie\'s" original plan to reunite with Gemma, which is bound to set up a string of compelling storylines for Season 3.'}

{'text': 'There was a three-year gap between the first and second seasons of "Severance," during which multiple factors caused delays, including script rewrites, reshoots, and the Hollywood strikes.'}

{'text': 'If Season 3 takes 6 to 9 months to film, followed by roughly six months of post-production, "Severance" is likely to return in the fall of 2027, just under three years after the previous season.'}

{'text': 'When do you expect "Severance" Season 3 to premiere? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.'}
